title: The frontend's declaration is a shortened version of DR1's: it drops the Regulation (EU) 2017/625 undertaking, compresses the responsibility statement so it no longer says when responsibility starts, and narrows all four accountability commitments.

controls.text: I confirm I am responsible for this consignment.
I confirm that I am accountable for:

finding.frontend: The page shows three headings and one bullet list, from src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/declaration/copy/copy.en.js:3-18. Heading one is 'I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK.' with nothing under it. Heading two is 'I confirm I am responsible for this consignment until it has cleared border control checks or reached the place of destination.' with nothing under it. Heading three is 'I confirm that I am accountable for:' over four bullets: 'payments for border control checks', 're-dispatch of the consignment', 'quarantine or isolation of the animals', 'the costs of destruction and disposal'. The two closing paragraphs about acting for a third party, and the confirmation checkbox label, match DR1 word for word.
finding.prototype: DR1 says more under each heading (app/views/declaration.html:40-64). Under 'I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK.' it adds 'I am complying with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 including on animal health and welfare.' — a sentence with no counterpart in the frontend at all. The responsibility heading is the short 'I confirm I am responsible for this consignment.', and the scope is stated below it: 'I am responsible from the submission of this notification to when it enters Great Britain. And I am responsible until it has either:' followed by 'cleared official checks at the border' and 'reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification'. The accountability bullets are wider than the frontend's: 'any payment for the official controls at the border', 'any arrangements to re-dispatch the consignment', 'any costs needed for quarantine or isolation of consignments', and 'any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities'.
finding.difference: Replace the declaration copy with DR1's, in English and Welsh. Add the Regulation (EU) 2017/625 sentence as a paragraph under the first heading; shorten the second heading and put the start-and-end-of-responsibility wording and its two bullets underneath it; and restate all four accountability bullets in DR1's terms. This is a legal statement the user is asked to affirm, so it has to be taken whole rather than approximated: the frontend's version currently commits the user to less than DR1 asks for, and says nothing about when responsibility begins. Copy files only — the checkbox, its label and the date line already match.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the Regulation (EU) 2017/625 sentence, the start-of-responsibility wording and DR1's four accountability bullets somewhere else in the frontend's declaration page.
finding.correction: Verified clause by clause against the rendered DOM on both sides and against both page screenshots, not against source or the author's transcription. Every quoted string is verbatim and every claim holds. Frontend (capture/html/frontend/fe-declaration.html:119-151): three h2 headings with no body text under the first two — 'I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK.', 'I confirm I am responsible for this consignment until it has cleared border control checks or reached the place of destination.', 'I confirm that I am accountable for:' — then four bullets 'payments for border control checks', 're-dispatch of the consignment', 'quarantine or isolation of the animals', 'the costs of destruction and disposal'. DR1 (capture/html/prototype/dr1-declaration.html:241-263): same first heading plus the paragraph 'I am complying with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 including on animal health and welfare.'; second heading is the short 'I confirm I am responsible for this consignment.' followed by 'I am responsible from the submission of this notification to when it enters Great Britain. And I am responsible until it has either:' and the bullets 'cleared official checks at the border' and 'reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification'; four accountability bullets 'any payment for the official controls at the border', 'any arrangements to re-dispatch the consignment', 'any costs needed for quarantine or isolation of consignments', 'any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities'. The two third-party paragraphs and the checkbox label are byte-identical across the two DOMs. One nuance the finding glosses: the date line matches in words but not in emphasis — DR1 renders the date inside a ('Date of declaration: 19 August 2026'), the frontend renders it as plain body text. That is presentation, so the slot stands as written. A second nuance for whoever implements: the frontend keeps an approximation of DR1's two end-of-responsibility conditions inside its long heading ('cleared border control checks or reached the place of destination'), so what is lost is the start of responsibility, the precision of the two conditions, and their separation from the heading — not the conditions wholesale.
